items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Yes, I remember, Prince George too.

ctx.x: realize the British have been supporting American music, that would be dance music and jazz for some 70 years, and the Prince of Wales, Edward the VIII was an amateur drummer.
Yes, I remember, Prince George too.

Yes, and the British really love jazz. I mean, they are quite serious about it. They do turn out for a wellknown American soloist, and the British have some damned good players now themselves. They have been dedicated to music.
